frame.converter: Astropy SkyCoord Galactic to ICRS, heliocentric Cartesian

meaning: Giant molecular clouds compiled by Hou & Han (2014) as spiral tracers: each at its photometric or trigonometric distance where published, otherwise at the authors' kinematic distance for R0 = 8.3 kpc (D8.3).

appearance.note: Presentation only: a violet a shade deeper than the Miville-Deschênes clouds.
appearance.emphasis: Arm tracer: young, massive star formation that outlines the spiral arms, drawn at full strength.

mapWeight.basis: Hou & Han (2014), Sect. 2.4 and Eq. 2: a weight for the kind of tracer, times 0.5/σ in each disc axis (1 when σ < 0.5 kpc) for a kinematic distance, with σ from a ±7 km/s velocity uncertainty through a flat rotation curve (R0 = 8.3 kpc, Θ0 = 239 km/s, their adopted set). W_GMC = log10(M / 10^4 Msun), M8.3 in 10^5 Msun.
